dataList.content:
Inch by inch, the Warden's hunched back began to straighten...
看守弯曲的背慢慢伸直了起来……

And the ominous, cold light gradually took on a brilliant golden hue.
颜色冷淡的光，渐渐染成了耀眼的金色。

... Can't remember the last time I got to stretch my back in the Grand Magasin.
……距离上次在百货店里伸直腰背，不知道已经过了多久了。

<He's... completely changed...>
<气氛变了。>

*sigh* Meursault, the sinful one... Dante, Executive Manager of Limbus Company... and the rest of the team, I presume.
哈……有罪之人默尔索和……边狱公司的但丁经理……还有，其同伴们。

Who... are you?
您是……哪位？

Ah. I should've introduced myself earlier. I am the Voice of the Obsidian God of Le Noir, the Warden who watches over those condemned to the Sisyphe Penalty... and one of the four Giants of Grand Magasin Sisyphe.
啊……自我介绍有些晚了。吾乃黑派所追随的漆黑之神的声音……也是负责监视被判西西弗刑的有罪之人的看守……还是西西弗百货的巨人之一。

Ah, what am I saying? Let's exchange our business cards and save us the trouble. Here's mine.
不，比起这样，还是直接递名片比较好吧。来，收下吧。

The Warden... the man, I mean, gave a casual wave of his hand. A business card fluttered down in front of us.
曾是看守的人……轻轻动了动手，名片便飘落到我们面前。

Printed on the disturbingly ordinary business card was the title "Giant - N Corp. Grand Magasin Sisyphe"... and a name.
非常普通的名片上，写着N公司西西弗百货巨人的职称……和名字。

... Maurice. The Chaplain.
……牧师莫里斯。

Just call me "Chaplain." Your mother did, too.
称呼吾为牧师就好。汝的母亲也是如此称呼吾的。

You'd not reveal your true form without cause. Have you come to issue an ultimatum?
你不会毫无理由地现出真身吧……是来警告我们的吗？

We're rather past the warning stage, wouldn't you say?
警告的阶段早都过去了吧。

I mean, you people certainly don't look like the sort who'd let death and eternal recurrence get in the way of whatever you're after...
就算杀掉送回去，也看不出来谁会放弃……

And there's the entire Sisyphe System being on the fritz ever since the White Nights and Dark Days phenomenon—whatever it did to the Grand Magasin, something's letting bothersome headaches like you slip through the rules.
虽然不知道怎么回事，但自从白夜黑昼以来，西西弗系统好像就出问题了……甚至出现了像汝等这样违反规则的麻烦家伙。

So I've come to lock you up forever in some miserable corner.
所以，吾是来将汝等永远关在某个地方的。

Forever...?
永远……吗？

That man, Meursault, has been sentenced to the Sisyphe Penalty. Even a lifetime spent observing the rules of this place and repenting his crime would scarcely suffice...
既然被判处了西西弗刑，那么就算忠实地顺应这里的规律，忏悔自身的罪生活下去也仍不够……

... So... when he insists on circumventing the rules, killing essential customers left and right... "It hath become self-evident that the sincerity of the sinful one is suspect—his penitence, perforce, hath come under the selfsame doubt...!" ... is what I'm getting at.
却还一次又一次违背规律、肆意妄为的话……不是会让人很怀疑有罪之人的诚意吗……！就是这样。

You're saying you're here because we broke the rules and tried to leave this department store with Meursault.
是因为我们违背了规律，想要和默尔索先生一起离开百货店对吧。

*chuckle* Truth be told, I couldn't care less about you leaving this place or taking the convict with you, though I couldn't tell you if that's even possible.
哈。实际上，吾并不介意有罪之人和汝等一起离开百货店。虽然吾也不知道那可不可能。

But when you start defying fate—that is, the Sisyphe System itself—you create serious problems for both the quality and quantity of the Experience Batter this department store produces.
但，汝等开始反抗命运……反抗西西弗系统的那一刻……西西弗百货生产的经验面团的质量和产量都会出现重大问题。

Doesn't the idea terrify you? The collapse of order and the truths as established by N Corp.?
不觉得可怕吗？N公司建立的规律和真理都会崩塌。

Where order falls, only barbarism will remain.
规律一旦崩塌，剩下的只有野蛮吧。

N Corp. would revert to its old ways. Scouring every Backstreet and Nest out there, driving nails into people's brains to harvest their experience fresh from the flesh... like savages.
那样的话N公司又会像以前那样，用钉子刺穿各个后巷、各个巢中人们的大脑，以直接获取经验。

... Therefore, in accordance with the rules of the Sisyphe System, I hereby quarantine Meursault, who is guilty of murdering a Giant, into solitary confinement.
因此……遵循西西弗系统的规律，需要将杀害巨人的默尔索隔离开来。

... I'll see you when you're ready to repent.
……待汝悔改之时，吾等再会。

H-hey...!
啊啊……？

Do you mind closing the door, Meursault? Don't let a single ray of sunlight in—I don't want a single gaze to peer in.
把房门关上，默尔索。不要让任何阳光进来。也不要让任何视线进来。

<color=#7d7d7d>Remember... and reflect upon the sin you committed with those hands.</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>以汝自己的手，犯下了何种罪行……回想起来吧。</color>

Ghk... Kergh...
咳……咳咳……

I killed Mother.
我杀了妈妈。

<color=#7d7d7d>Now, that's not exactly the kind of crime
that can be dressed up as the mistake of youthful foolishness, is it?
Even when viewed through the most sympathetic lens,
it's a bizarre, nonsensical crime that goes against the very idea of common sense.</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>可不是用一时冲动……那种话就能掩饰的事情吧？无论怎么宽容来看。也都不合常理吧。</color>

<color=#7d7d7d>What you did left N Corp. facing consequences that could not be undone, to say the least.</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>因为汝所做的事，给N公司带来了无可挽回的后果啊。</color>

<color=#7d7d7d>Everyone was shocked. To murder your own mother in such a cruel manner...
People were outraged at the sheer... inhumanity.</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>所有人都很震惊。竟然用那样残忍的方式杀害了自己的母亲……汝可真是没人性。</color>

<color=#7d7d7d>It won't be a prison that confines you... nor the Grand Magasin Sisyphe.</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>将汝关起来的不会是监狱……也不会是西西弗百货吧。</color>

<color=#7d7d7d>A sinner is imprisoned by his sin. It's that simple.
By rights, you should remain confined here to face your sins, learning regret and repentance.</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>有罪之人只是被自身的罪关起来而已。难道不应该囚禁于此，彻底直面自身的罪，后悔，并悔改吗？</color>

Mother generally returns from work at approximately 19:10. I arrive home somewhat earlier, at 18:00.
妈妈大概19点10分回家，我回家的时间稍早，大约是18点。

The first thing I do is close every window that I've left open to air out the house.
先回家的我，将为了通风而打开的窗户全部关上了。

Then I draw the black curtains over them, obscuring the view outside.
然后，用全黑的窗帘遮住外面的景色。

Welcome home, Mother.
欢迎回家，妈妈。

... The windows and curtains. Have you closed them all?
……窗户和窗帘，都关好了吗？

Yes.
是的。

Mother was terrified of the world—the gaze of others.
妈妈害怕这个世界，也害怕别人的视线。

She never went out without sunglasses. Even when walking down the street, she kept her head lowered, eyes fixed adamantly on the ground.
出门时一定要戴上墨镜，走路时总是低着头，只看着地面。

At 19:30, Mother and I dine together.
19点30分，和妈妈一起吃晚饭。

Commit those looking eyes to memory. Those people may not mean any harm when they look at me, but...
记住，那些眼神。那些人可能并不是带着恶意看我……

Once a gaze captures me... the beholder, whether meaning to or not, will nail me in place, fixing me inside their brain.
但一旦被视线捕捉到……我就会被那个人的大脑所钉住，固定。

My very existence, taken away, pinned down, and framed to be remembered however they please.
我的存在……就那么被夺走，被固定，随意地被记忆。

Aah, how awful is that...? Just the thought of it is more than I can bear.
啊啊，好可怕……只是想想就害怕得不得了。

Mother recounts the things that distressed her throughout the day. Throughout every part of her daily life.
妈妈在所有日常中，都会倾诉一天中让她感到痛苦的事。

We have no choice... but to stay nailed and fixed... once someone's gaze has hold of us.
一旦被谁的视线所囚禁……我们……就只能那样被固定住了。

Think about it... All those people you passed by today, eating their evening Canned Experiences just as we do... And when you—your existence, taxidermied in someone's memory—happens to surface... you have no choice but to exist. To exist in a way you never even wanted...
今天擦肩而过的那么多人……都会像我们一样，在家中食用晚餐经验罐头吧……随后，当那人的记忆中突然浮现出被做成标本般的你的存在时……你就不得不以一种自己从未想要过的方式存在了……

I'm afraid, Meursault... But I wish at least you could be free of this fear. Ah... If that's even possible...
好可怕……默尔索，但只要你能够不害怕就好……啊……但是，真的能做到那样吗……

As always, the conclusion of mother's despair is a conversation with herself.
一如既往，妈妈的绝望最终归向了指向她自己的话语。

I listen attentively to every utterance, but I answer none of it.
我全心聆听妈妈说的每一句话，但不对任何事情作出回答。

I merely prepare the meal, as family should, as a son should... and eat Canned Experiences with her.
只是像家人一样，像儿子一样……准备食物，一起食用经验罐头。

There is neither despair nor fear in the can.
罐头里，没有绝望也没有恐惧。

Mother and I get to spend a peaceful and pleasant evening together. As a happy, loving family.
我和妈妈度过了一个平静、舒适、和谐的夜晚。

Mother has a long, heavy chain hanging in the most conspicuous part of the living room.
妈妈在客厅最显眼的地方，挂着一条又长又重的锁链。

For us, it was... a symbol, an indicator—something that could alleviate not just her fears but mine as well.
那是缓解我和妈妈……缓解我们恐惧的象征和标志。

This chain in our home is a reminder, Meursault. I always look at it to tell myself that I need to be careful.
默尔索，妈妈看着家里的这条锁链，总会记起自己需要小心。

You can feel them out there, can't you? The people who exist. People who are watching us without even realizing that they are watching us.
能感受到外面人们的存在吧？那些可能看着这里却没能意识到的，看着这里的人们的存在。

Your maman... I've... always been tethered to that feeling, and it has wrung every part of me... dry.
妈妈……这一生都是带着这种感觉，整个人都被紧紧束缚着活过来的。

People make me afraid.
所以，不管在哪里，只要有人我就会害怕。

They remember me however they like, then they expect whatever they like. And then, I fail to fit...
擅自将我记忆并抱有期待，却有着偏差……

All of it drags me deeper like ponderous weights. Makes me afraid.
这一切让我感到沉重，也让我害怕。

Each pair of eyes is a chain that is forced upon my limbs, pulling in all directions until I'm ripped apart into unrecognizable pieces...
感觉就像他们每个人都将锁链硬生生绑在我的身上，将我的手脚全部扯碎一样。

Mother was in pain. Her limbs were intact, yet she felt the pain of having her arms and legs torn from her.
妈妈很痛苦。她那些未被扯碎的手脚，也无一例外地感受着被扯碎的痛苦。

How do you... endure the pain of being torn apart, Mother?
那么……您是如何忍耐被扯碎的痛苦的呢，妈妈。

Perhaps it was something from the question. Relief crossed Mother's face as she directed her gaze toward the ceiling, like a supplicant graced by a holy relic, our salvation...
听到这个问题，妈妈露出了放心的表情，就好像看到了唯一能够拯救我们的神圣存在一样……

... the chains hanging in our home.
她指向了挂在家里的锁链。

You chain yourself before the chains of others bind you.
在被他人的锁链绑住之前，先自己把锁链缠在自己身上。

The chains will hold you down... but at least you needn't be hurt.
即使被锁链缠住动弹不得……至少，能够避免痛苦吧。

They'll take the wounds meant for your skin, as armor to deflect the pain...
那会替代你的皮肤，成为防止痛苦的铠甲……

People say only nails and hammers can fix something in place. But for me, chains can bind, too. Chains can affix. So I have faith in the chain.
钉与锤能固定东西。但对我来说并非如此。用锁链也能够绑住，固定。我是如此相信的。
It almost sounded as though she were saying, "I must have faith in the chain." Because that is how desperate she looked. 大概是必须那么相信吧。妈妈看起来是如此的迫切。

<color=#7d7d7d>Continue to look upon it. Face the fear of the sinful one.</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>……继续直视吧。有罪之人的恐惧。</color>

The door...
房门……

Do you mind closing the door, Meursault? Don't let a single ray of sunlight in—I don't want a single gaze to peer in. Keep them all out; don't let me bear their gazes.
把房门关上，默尔索。不要让任何阳光进来。也不要让任何视线进来。不要让任何人进来，也不要被任何人盯着看。

Mother would always set some time aside for herself. She would go into her room, alone, and shut the door.
妈妈总有属于她一人的时间。一个人进入房间，关上房门的时间。

I didn't know what she did inside. But watching that closed door, knowing that she was inside that room all by herself, terrified me.
我不知道里面在做什么。不过，守着待在里面的妈妈，对我来说是件可怕的事。

These periods only grew longer after Father left. Mother said that she needed that time—the time spent alone in that room—to endure living.
爸爸离开后，时间变得更长了。妈妈说，如果没有一个人待在房间里的时间……她就无法忍耐活着。

No one was to enter. There were no exceptions.
而且，在那段时间里，谁都不能进入房间，无一例外。

<color=#7d7d7d>... Continue to look upon it. Behold the truth that terrifies the sinful one.</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>……继续直视吧。有罪之人的畏惧。</color>

What was she doing in there? What keeps her going through the pain?
妈妈在里面做什么呢。是什么让妈妈能够在那种痛苦中忍耐的呢。

Those were not questions born of curiosity.
那并非是好奇心。

They were concern.
是担心，

They were fear.
是恐惧。

What I needed was certainty—the reassurance that nothing bad was happening to Mother inside that room.
我需要的是知道妈妈在里面没出任何问题的确信和安心。

And so...
所以……
Why?! WHY?!! 为什么？为什么！！！！

I'm afraid... So afraid...!!
可怕！好可怕！！

After that day, I decided to never look at my mother again.
那件事之后，我就决定再也不去看妈妈了。

I had to continue protecting what little peace she found in solitude.
我必须守护妈妈独自一人的安宁。

Otherwise, I would become the nail, the hammer, and the chains that constrict her and keep her fixed.
否则的话，我就会变成钉，变成锤，变成锁链，紧紧束缚住妈妈。

Regardless of my intent.
无论我意愿如何，那都会发生。

Close... the door, Meursault...
把房门……关上……默尔索……

Mother and I were bound together.
我与妈妈绑在一起。

As a being conceptually perceived as "mother," Mother gave birth to me, conferring a shared genetic identity between us.
妈妈，通过妈妈这个概念将我生了出来，赋予了我身体上基因的同一性。

And this obliged us to believe and act as though we were connected with an unbreakable, sublime bond—an ethical, moral insistence that this was simply how a parent and son ought to be. We had long since been bound to each other by that insistence.
为此，我和妈妈必须表现得好像被某种坚固而崇高的东西联系在一起。当然，很早以前我们就被那种亲子之间本该如此的伦理道德捆绑住了。

We were born into a world that required us to feel that way.
我们诞生在必须如此感觉的世界里，

Or perhaps it was simply a matter of human nature, designed to feel that way.
也许人的本性就是被设计成会感到那样的感觉的。

*retch*
呃……

There would be days when I found myself asking why things had to be this way...
但是某一日，突然，我冒出了为什么非得如此的想法……

Days when fear and vertigo would wash over me as well, leaving me stranded with no way back.
从那时起，我也感到了无可挽回的恐惧与晕眩。

I followed Mother's instructions. To protect myself, to save myself, I looked at the chain hanging in our home and reminded myself.
就像妈妈曾嘱咐过的那样，我为了保护自己，看着挂在家中的锁链，提醒自己。

And I tried my utmost not to nail "Mother" or "her" or "a being" in place,
然后我努力不让妈妈，她，某个存在被钉住。

because I understood the terror of being nailed down.
因为我知道被钉住有多么可怕。

O Sinful One, you are afraid.
有罪之人感到恐惧。

You are in pain. You are suffering.
痛苦，难受吧。

There is but one way to make it stop. Repent your sins and submit to the law of the Grand Magasin. It is not too late.
停止的方法只有一个。从现在起悔改你的罪，顺应百货店的规则。

Then, contribute to the humanity N Corp. seeks to uphold, as all convicts here do.
像这里所有的有罪之人一样，为N公司所追求的人性作出贡献吧。

Yes, I am suffering.
没错，我很难受。

I want nothing more than to coil the chains around my body, just as my dead mother told me to.
正如死去的妈妈所说，我想用锁链缠绕自己的全身。

Let your sins define you within the Grand Magasin.
由这家百货店，来定义你的罪吧。

Here in this place, sinners need only submit to the punishment imposed upon them.
在这里的有罪之人，只需要遵从执行的刑罚就好。

If you feel even the slightest pang of conscience and remorse for killing your mother...
如果汝对杀死母亲而感到哪怕一丝良心的谴责和后悔的话。

Then surrender, for that is what you are duty-bound to feel as her son! That is the burden of sin you must bear as a resident of N Corp.!
那是作为孩子应有的感情，也是作为N公司居民应当承担的罪业报应！
